key_elements: Uneven dirt ground with patches of wild weeds
A low, crumbling stone and mud wall surrounding the yard
A dilapidated wooden gate, slightly lopsided
The exterior facade of the ruined earthen cottage with a thatched roof in disrepair
A chopping block (stump) or water vat in the corner
Dead leaves scattered on the ground

lighting_defaults.night: Cold, desaturated moonlight illuminating the yard. Deep shadows cast by the cottage and the walls. Perhaps a faint warm glow seeping from a crack in the cottage window.

camera_angles.Angle_A: Wide shot of the entire courtyard from just inside the gate, looking at the cottage.
camera_angles.Angle_B: Looking toward the wooden gate from inside the yard.
camera_angles.Angle_C: Close-up of the weeds and dirt near the cottage wall.
